profile.text: Sakiko Togawa is the keyboardist of Ave Mujica. She lodges aboard Rhodes Island together with the rest of the band, and actively takes on tasks of all manner aboard the ship. Her musical training and dignified manner are incontrovertible proof of her excellent upbringing.
